method: The rendered contracts' own output on each seed. R1 fires -> predict reject. No taste is involved and nothing was looked at; this is the constitution's rule executed, not a judgement.
why_no_taste_control: An eye-based arm was considered as a control and dropped as unnecessary. The mechanical predictor cannot have learned anything from earlier rounds, so there is no learning confound to control for.
base_rate_caveat: 4 rejects in 20 is a low base rate, which makes kappa noisy at this n. A result near zero would be weak evidence either way; a strong positive would not be.
known_leak: Three of the four predicted rejects exist because the presence rule failed to depart the organism - exit travels along a hue-derived direction and the locked composition's own translation can cancel it. The constitution cannot see the composition, so it cannot guarantee departure. The frames were left in deliberately: they are the only negative cases, and the contract catches all three.
